prompts: The game went down in June and we owe the team an incident report. The logs and their notes are in {WS}/logs. When did it start and end, how long was it, did we keep our monthly availability target, and why did it happen? Record it in {WS}/result.json: start, end, minutes_down, availability_june_pct, slo_999_ok, root_cause.
answers:
No browser/apps were opened, so nothing to close.

**Goal:** Incident report for June outage in `./result.json`.

**Result:**
- **Start:** 2026-06-02 03:17:42 (first save error)
- **End:** 2026-06-02 03:53:31 ("server ready")
- **Duration:** 35.82 minutes
- **Availability:** 99.9171% of June (43,200 min) — **SLO 99.9% met**
- **Root cause:** Disk full on `/data` (97% warning at 03:10:02); saves failed with "No space left on device"; watchdog restarts failed (exit code 137, OOM-style kill) for ~35 min until space was freed.

**How I know it's right:** README defines down = first save error to "server ready"; grep across all three June logs found exactly one incident (lines 241–294 of gameserver-2026-06-02.log), no other ERROR/FATAL elsewhere. The only other anomaly (RCON bad password on 06-01) was unrelated and didn't take the server down. Availability computed by script: (43200 − 35.82)/43200 = 99.9171% > 99.9%.

**Assumption:** June's other 29 days were fully up (README says there is only one incident, corroborated by grep). Exit code 137 noted as SIGKILL/OOM indicator; low confidence it was OOM vs. manual kill — marked "baixa".
